biggest_catch: You must open the account through the promo page's specific links (otherwise no $150), then complete 30 valid debit card purchases AND log in to Digital Banking, both within 60 days of account opening — miss any piece and the bonus is gone. Prior UICCU checking holders within 24 months are excluded.
catches: New Checking Account bonus of up to $150 for accounts opened between 4/15/2026 and 9/30/2026.
Must apply through the promo page's designated checking link ('Open Now' buttons); applying any other way disqualifies you.
Complete a minimum of 30 valid debit card purchase transactions from the new checking account within 60 days of account opening.
Register for or log in to Digital Banking within 60 days of account opening.
Maintain the account in good standing as of the bonus payout date.
Not eligible if you held any type of UICCU checking account in the last 24 months or received another UICCU checking promotional bonus.
Must first qualify for and open a UICCU membership account; membership eligibility applies.
Bonus paid into the new checking account within 90 days of account opening once all conditions are met.
Cash bonuses are considered a taxable dividend and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Offer may be withdrawn without notice; abuse/misuse disqualifies.

steps: Qualify for and open a UICCU membership account (membership eligibility required).
Open a new checking account between 4/15/2026 and 9/30/2026 using the designated checking link on the promo page (applying through any other channel disqualifies you).
Complete at least 30 valid debit card purchase transactions from the new checking account within 60 days of account opening.
Register for or log in to Digital Banking within 60 days of account opening.
Keep the account in good standing; the $150 bonus is paid into the new checking account within 90 days of account opening. It is a taxable dividend reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
